identity.description: Pipedrive is a CRM and sales-pipeline SaaS product (deals, persons, organizations, leads, activities, products, pipelines). Its developer docs are at developers.pipedrive.com and the product site is pipedrive.com.
identity.identity_notes: Sources describe Pipedrive as the CRM with deals, persons, organizations, leads and activities, matching the assignment. Developer docs domain is developers.pipedrive.com; several subpages I guessed returned 404, so only the v1 landing page was read directly.

auth.oauth_flows: Authorization-code style OAuth 2.0 is used by the official hosted MCP server (sign-in and authorize in the browser). Third-party review says OAuth 2.0 with authorize/token endpoints at oauth.pipedrive.com is required for Marketplace apps; not confirmed on an official page.
auth.scopes_notes: Not established from fetched official pages.

access.production_restrictions: Marketplace listing requires OAuth authorization-code flow per third-party review; no official source fetched on app review.

api.rate_limits: Conflicting third-party figures (token-budget model; burst limits per 2 seconds, e.g. 20/40 for API token and 80/160 for OAuth apps per a search summary). Not confirmed on an official page; treat as unknown.
api.limitations: Official v1 docs page did not state base URL or rate limits; v2 docs page and several subpages returned 404 during research. API v2 is the newer version; v1 still used for some entities (notes, mail, users, leads CRUD per a community post).

open_questions: Official OAuth 2.0 docs (scopes, token expiry, refresh, app registration) were not retrieved; developers.pipedrive.com oauth, Authorization and v2 subpages returned 404.
Exact API token location and whether the API is available on the free/trial plan tier is not verified; tier left unknown.
Rate limits conflict across third-party sources; need official developer docs (readme.io rate-limiting page) to confirm.
Official SDKs: a third-party review mentions Node.js and PHP SDKs; not confirmed on an official page.
Webhook payloads, versions and registration method not verified on official docs.
Whether mcp.pipedrive.ai/mcp is the vendor's canonical server URL should be checked on a Pipedrive page.
Official GitHub org/MCP repo not located; no vendor-owned MCP source code confirmed (the official MCP may be hosted only).

assessment.approach: Wrap/benchmark vendor's official MCP server; add managed auth
